title: LIVE TRADER TICK RUNS AT ~92% OF ITS 60 s INTERVAL (order-path latency, real money). FIX DIRECTION (Tier 2): narrow the journal lock to the DB writes only (do venue reads outside the hold), and profile the three biggest sweeps (venue calls per open row?).
